First, since ${v}_{1}+{v}_{2}=0,$ we have that 

$$
\begin{aligned}6{v}_{1}-7{v}_{2} & =13{v}_{1}-7{v}_{1}-7{v}_{2} \\  & =13{v}_{1}-7({v}_{1}+{v}_{2}) \\  & =13{v}_{1}-7(0) \\  & =13{v}_{1}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
T(6{v}_{1}-7{v}_{2})=T(13{v}_{1}).
$$

Now, since $T$ is a linear transformation, we have that $T(kv)=kT(v).$ So 

$$
\begin{aligned}T(13{v}_{1}) & =13T({v}_{1}) \\  & =13[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}52 \\ -13 \\ 39\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

In conclusion, $T(6{v}_{1}-7{v}_{2})=[\begin{aligned}52 \\ -13 \\ 39\end{aligned}].$
